weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the significance of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, which is central to the results.
Numerical experiments are mentioned but lack detailed descriptions of methodologies and comparisons to existing approaches.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the proposed method, particularly in scenarios with non-monotone loss functions.
strengths: The paper presents a novel extension of conformal prediction that broadens its applicability to various loss functions.
The theoretical results are well-founded, providing rigorous guarantees for the proposed conformal risk control framework.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method across multiple real-world tasks, showcasing its practical relevance.
